newsitem.title: USA: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Compaq active, strategies vary.
newsitem.headline: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Compaq active, strategies vary.

text.p: Compaq Computer Corp options were heavily traded on Thursday amid various strategies as the stock bounced in a wide range, traders said.
The Compaq September 60 call traded more than 10,100 contracts by afternoon, putting it atop the actives list. Through Wednesday, the option's open interest was 6,576.
With Compaq shares down 5/8 at 56-1/2, the September 60 call was off 1/16 at 7/16.
"People were trying to sell them before they went to zero," Harrison Roth, a first vice president at Cowen & Co, said of the September 60 call action.
Traders said most of the Compaq options activity was from institutional investors in both calls and puts.
The Compaq September 45 call and put each traded about 5,000 contracts, the September 55 call traded about 3,750 and the September 50 put traded nearly 3,700. The September 60 put traded about 4,450.
"The September 55s is anybody's guess," Roth said of potential strategies.
"But with the range the stock had, somebody could have run in to buy them at the low," he said.
Compaq shares traded between 54-1/2 and 57-3/8. Consolidated volume topped six million shares by late trade.

Compaq's chairman and chief executive Eckhard Pfeiffer told Reuters on Thursday the computer maker was on track for a strong second half but said analysts were "getting ahead of themselves" with a $1.06 a share third quarter consensus profit forecast.

"It looks like there have been some players in and out of both the calls and puts," said Marty Kearney at PTI Securities. He added that specific strategies were difficult to determine because the trading was so scattered.
In other activity, a spread was seen in Delta Air Lines Inc September 70 puts and the October 70 puts.
Both contracts traded 2,700 times, with most of the September 70s crossing at 2-13/16 and the bulk of the October 70s crossing at 4-1/8.
Also, several options on shares of Gap Inc drew interest as the stock tumbled after the company reported flat same-store sales for August.
By late afternoon, Gap shares were down 4-7/8 at 29 in New York Stock Exchange trading.
Among the options, which trade on the Chicago Board Options Exchange, the October 30 call traded more than 2,000 contracts. It lost 3-1/4 to 1-3/8. Through Wednesday, its open interest was five.
Other active Gap options included the September 30 call, the September 35 call and the September 27-1/2 put.
Several Campbell Soup Co calls were active on the NYSE as the stock rallied after the company announced a $2.5 billion stock buyback and other initiatives to boost profits.
